# An assignment's target is checked with narrowing off, and the hint for an
# undefined `this` loads the libraries the program has not: their bodies
# are checked with narrowing on, so the error is the program's own and not
# sngl:settings' `s.scope != null ? s.scope : ""`.
! sngl check main.sngl
stderr 'main.sngl:8:5: undefined: this — box.set takes no box, so it is static'
! stderr 'settings.sngl'

-- main.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component box(:value string = "a") ui.node {
    ui.text(value)
}

func box.set(v string) {
    this.value = v
}

component main ui.node {
    box()
}
